#3092 -- [SPIR-V] Allow thread group size to be specified with specialization constants
https://github.com/microsoft/DirectXShaderCompiler/issues/3092

WHAT TO LOOK FOR: every pane FAILS, including the Clang one. The line to read
in each is

    error: 'numthreads' attribute requires an integer constant

TGSIZE_X is a Vulkan specialization constant, and [numthreads] will not take
one -- which is the whole of the request. There is no spelling today that makes
the SPIR-V workgroup size depend on a specialization constant.

The syntax below is the one @s-perron asked for on the issue in 2023.

hlsl_clang_trunk is here because the HLSL front end is being rebuilt in Clang,
so "has the successor already answered this?" is the more useful question on a
five-year-old request. It has not: same diagnostic, same wording.

Four things this page cannot show, all measured and recorded in the triage
evidence, and quoted in the issue comment:
  * with TGSIZE_X changed to `static const uint`, the same shader compiles in
    BOTH compilers and emits `OpExecutionMode %main LocalSize 4 1 1` -- so the
    restriction is specific to specialization constants, not to named constants
    generally, and the Clang failure above is not stage or backend noise;
  * with the spec constant declared and used but the workgroup size written as
    a literal, both compilers emit `SpecId 1` and an `OpSpecConstant` -- so
    [[vk::constant_id]] itself works in both;
  * `[[vk::constant_id(1)]] static const uint` is rejected in turn, with
    "specialization constant must be externally visible", so no declaration
    satisfies both requirements;
  * the same diagnostic appears in every DXC release from v1.5.2010 to
    v1.9.2607. v1.4.1907 cannot answer at all -- "SPIR-V CodeGen not available".
